# Yu theme source

- Source: <https://github.com/jianghurong/juejin-markdown-theme-yu>
- Pinned commit: `1e3096f`
- Upstream file: `yu.scss`
- Upstream theme license: MIT
- Registered in juejin-markdown-themes as `yu` (highlight: atom-one-dark)

`yu.scss` is an unmodified source snapshot retained for local comparison and
traceability. It is not included in WeiSome application resources or packages.

WeiSome adapts only article-content rules to Compose preview styles and inline
HTML export. The `.markdown-body` grid background is not applied: the export is
a block fragment with no body wrapper. The strong `·` dashes and the
blockquote/table hover styles are pseudo-element or interactive effects the
inline-CSS model cannot express. Code-block colors continue to come from
WeiSome's selected code theme.
